interpretation: Bounded-proposal disagreement search removes the need to enumerate all 1024 inputs in the SHADOW-ADD identification problem. With proposal budget 8 and at most four expected-action queries, all 1500 trials resolve the true ADD source with zero wrong resolutions and zero abstentions; mean oracle queries are about 1.10. Random probing with the same four-query cap resolves only about 68.3% and safely abstains on the rest. The trade-off is additional source evaluations inside the proposal set.
claim_boundary: Candidate inputs are still sampled from a known finite 32x32 input generator; expected common actions are supplied by an oracle/query channel. Source proposal evaluation is not itself counted as an oracle-label query. This does not yet show active query synthesis in open-ended natural-language or continuous domains.
